EVIDENCE BEFORE EXPECTATIONS

About this workspace

This version uses your supplied 2025–26 Basketball Reference advanced statistics. It includes 15 players with history and two players without a row in that source. Nick Richards uses his combined-season row.

All values describe individual historical performance. We have not trained a lineup prediction model or connected an AI report service. Notes are calculated directly from the displayed profiles.

Three-point attempt rate measures shot selection, not three-point accuracy. TS% measures scoring efficiency, including free throws. Defensive BPM, blocks, and steals are incomplete indicators of defense.

Player portraits are official NBA headshots. The court artwork is the exact Pat Riley Court image selected by you, from Basketball Jersey Archive. The half-court view rotates and crops that image without modifying the original file.
